name: @forge3d/web
description: Browser-only Forge3D WebGPU/WASM runtime for terrain rendering

scripts.build:ts: npm run generate:codecs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/embed-proj-worker.mjs
scripts.build:example: npm --prefix examples/vite install --package-lock=false && npm --prefix examples/vite run build
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts && npm run prepare-dist && npm run build:example
scripts.test:api: npm run typecheck && node tests/api/public-api-snapshot.mjs && node tests/api/emitted-facade-stage.mjs
scripts.test:package: node scripts/test-w22-basis-csp.mjs && npm run test:release-hardening && npm run test:browser-harness && npm run test:infrastructure && node tests/api/package-contract.mjs
scripts.test:w10: vitest run tests/unit/environment.test.ts && playwright test tests/playwright/w10_environment.spec.ts tests/playwright/w10_native.spec.ts --project=chromium-preflight
